title: 第 1 期 · 五个 EAP 主题
note: 保留原有主题学习内容；并非逐条核验的当日新闻报道。

articles.title: 大国之间为什么仍需要对话？
articles.titleEn: Why dialogue between major powers still matters
articles.en: Even when countries have conflicting interests, diplomatic engagement can reduce the risk of misunderstandings. However, negotiations do not necessarily translate into concrete progress.
articles.zh: 即使国家之间存在利益冲突，外交接触仍可能减少误判风险。不过，谈判不一定带来实质进展。
articles.question: Should rival countries continue talking even when they strongly disagree?

articles.title: 人工智能会改变大学学习吗？
articles.titleEn: How AI could reshape university learning
articles.en: AI can provide personalised support and improve access to information. Yet excessive reliance on automated answers may undermine independent thinking and widen existing inequalities.
articles.zh: 人工智能能够提供个性化支持、改善信息获取，但过度依赖自动生成的答案可能削弱独立思考，并扩大原有差距。
articles.question: Does AI make university students more independent or more dependent?

articles.title: 人工智能也有环境成本
articles.titleEn: The environmental cost of artificial intelligence
articles.en: Data centres consume substantial amounts of electricity. Voluntary environmental pledges may encourage transparency, but critics question whether they provide sufficient accountability.
articles.zh: 数据中心消耗大量电力。自愿环保承诺可能提升透明度，但也有人质疑其问责力度是否足够。
articles.question: Should governments impose stricter environmental rules on AI companies?

articles.title: 经济增长是否让每个人受益？
articles.en: Strong exports and rapid technological development do not automatically improve everyone's standard of living. The benefits of growth can be distributed unevenly across society.
articles.zh: 强劲出口与技术发展并不自动改善每个人的生活水平；经济增长的收益可能分配不均。
articles.question: Is economic growth meaningful if its benefits are unevenly shared?

articles.title: 大学应该教授理财知识吗？
articles.en: Financial literacy can equip young adults with practical skills, including budgeting and understanding financial risks. However, compulsory courses may add pressure to an already packed timetable.
articles.zh: 金融素养能帮助年轻人掌握预算规划和理解金融风险等实用技能，但必修课程也可能增加课业负担。
articles.question: Should financial education be compulsory at university?
